study_identification_part.si_4_title: Atypical maturation of the functional connectome hierarchy in autism

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABIDE-I and ABIDE-II (ASD and TD rs-fMRI datasets); HCP-D healthy developmental cohort used for normative modeling.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data from three large-scale datasets were analyzed: Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange I and II and Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (aged 5-22 years)."

answer.ABIDE-I: primary/discovery analyses (ASD vs TD) using centile scores from the normative model

answer.ABIDE-II: replication/reproducibility; longitudinal subset for additional validation

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative model built in HCP-D and transferred to ABIDE TD; ABIDE-I for primary analyses; ABIDE-II for replication and longitudinal check.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "A normative model for the gradient values was constructed using the HCP-D dataset and then transferred to the TD group of the ABIDE dataset." "We utilized ABIDE-I data for the primary normative modeling analyses, and the reproducibility was assessed using ABIDE-II data..." "we conducted an additional analysis using the ABIDE-II longitudinal dataset ( n =  38; Supplementary Table 3)."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Lee2025.pdf.md: Normative modeling; Lee2025.pdf.md: Normative modeling / Reproducibility; Lee2025.pdf.md: Normative modeling / Longitudinal analysis

model-1.model-name: GAMLSS normative model of functional gradient values

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "To construct a normative developmental trajectory, we used an additional cohort of 652 neurologically healthy children and adolescents from the Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D) dataset."
